Fenrir's Commanding Thrust.description: Upgrades the Polearm Normal Attack to summon phantom spears that strike the target. Deals double the damage of the standard attack.

Fenrir's Crescent Flurry.description: Upgrades the Katana Charged Attack. Upon striking an enemy, the character leaps into the air and slams down, dealing multiple hits to surrounding foes for double the damage of the standard attack.

Fenrir's Divine Herald Hunt.description: Increase Damage Dealt to The Elysian Church by 40%.

Fenrir's Edgeless Blade.description: Upgrades the Greatsword Normal Attack to unleash 3 swordwaves upon final hit, cleaving through enemies in your path for double the damage of the standard attack.

Fenrir's Fervor.description: Increases Movement Speed by 20% for 10s after defeating an enemy.

Fenrir's Filthoid Hunt.description: Increase Damage Dealt to Filthoids by 40%

Fenrir's Forsaken Hunt.description: Increase Damage Dealt to The Forsakens by 40%

Fenrir's In Full Bloom.description: Upgrades the Dual Blades Sliding Attack into a lethal dash, slashing through all enemies in your path for double the damage of the standard attack.

Fenrir's Legion Hunt.description: Increase Damage Dealt to Hyperborean Soldier by 40%.

Fenrir's Patrol.description: When triggering Bonus Effect, gains 1 stack that increases ATK Range by 0.6 for 10s, up to 2 stacks.

Fenrir's Piercing Ascent.description: Upgrades the Polearm Charged Attack to launch a forward dash, damaging enemies in the user's path for double the damage of the standard attack.

Fenrir's Puncture Cascade.description: Upgrades the Polearm Charged Attack to throw 5 polearms forward, attacking enemies in your path for double the damage of the standard attack.

Fenrir's Savage Charge.description: Upgrades the Greatsword Charged Attack to allow movement during charging while capturing controllable monsters along the path (up to 4). Spending combos extends the charging window, culminating in a powerful AOE attack upon release or timeout that deals double the damage of the standard attack.

Fenrir's Shockwave Echo.description: Upgrades the Polearm Plunging Attack to trigger a bigger shockwave on impact, dealing double the damage of the standard attack.

Fenrir's Sundering Edgefield.description: Upgrades Sword Charged Attack to deal double the damage of the standard attack.

Fenrir's Vigilance.description: When triggering Bonus Effect: Smash, gains 1 stack that increases CRIT Damage by 10% for 10s, up to 10 stacks.

Fenrir's Whirl of Illusion.description: Upgrades Sword Normal Attack to deal double the damage of the standard attack.

Fafnir's Divine Herald Hunt.description: Increases Damage Dealt to The Elysian Church by 40%.

Fafnir's Filthoid Hunt.description: Increases Damage Dealt to Filthoid by 40%.

Fafnir's Forsaken Hunt.description: Increases Damage Dealt to The Forsakens by 40%.

Fafnir's Legion Hunt.description: Increases Damage Dealt to Hyperborean Soldiers by 40%.

Fafnir's Frugality.description: When dealing damage, increase the damage according to the percentage of the remaining projectiles. The higher the percentage, the greater the increase, up to 30%.

Fafnir's Loadout.description: After reloading, increases ATK Speed by 45% for 10s.

Lilith's Rain of Quivers.description: Decreases the damage dealt by 60% (unaffected by other modifiers).
